PPV_FR_Act.pdf.title: The Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001 (Act No. 53 of 2001, as amended up to Act No. 33 of 2021)
PPV_FR_Act.pdf.authority: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority (PPV&FRA)
PPV_FR_Act.pdf.effective_date: 2005-11-11 (Sections 2-13, 95-97, per Notification No. S.O. 1588(E)); 2006-10-19 (Section 1, Sections 14-94, per Notification No. S.O. 1797(E)). Consolidated to reflect amendments up to the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 (Act No. 33 of 2021), effective 2021-04-04.
PPV_FR_Act.pdf.summary: This is the actual bare-act text (11 Chapters, 97 sections) — supersedes the brochure/compendium files previously in this corpus (DOC-PPVFR-BROCHURE-2018, DOC-PPVFR-REGISTRY-VOL1/VOL2) as the authoritative source for Section-level citations. IMPORTANT: Sections 54, 55, 58 and 59 were omitted by the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 (which abolished the Plant Varieties Protection Appellate Tribunal / IPAB) — appeals now go directly to the High Court under amended Sections 56-57, not to a Tribunal. Any answer citing the old PVPAT/IPAB appeal route is citing obsolete law; ground appeal-route answers in Sections 56-57 as they stand in this file.

WIPO Madrid Treaty.pdf.title: Madrid Agreement Concerning the International Registration of Marks (1891, as revised through 1979)

WIPO Madrid Treaty.pdf.summary: The older Madrid Agreement. For the international trademark filing route most current applicants actually use, see DOC-MADRID-PROTOCOL-1989 below — cite that one for practical filing guidance; use this one only for historical/legacy Agreement-specific questions (it remains formally in force between certain states, per Article 9sexies of the Protocol).

Madrid Protocol.pdf.title: Protocol Relating to the Madrid Agreement Concerning the International Registration of Marks
Madrid Protocol.pdf.summary: This is the currently dominant international trademark-registration instrument (most Madrid System members, including India, operate under this Protocol rather than the 1891 Agreement). Use this document, not the older Agreement, when advising on the practical international trademark filing route for export questions.

Geneva Act.pdf.title: Geneva Act of the Hague Agreement Concerning the International Registration of Industrial Designs
Geneva Act.pdf.summary: This is the currently dominant international industrial-design-registration instrument. Use this document, not the 1960 Act, when advising on the practical international design filing route for export/packaging-design questions.
